story: Code Age vs. Time to Recall
text: I think Adam Tornhill has a nice take on this. He recommends tech debt not be quantified as such, but encourages focusing on areas with high complexity and large churn GOTO 2019 • Prioritizing Technical Debt as if Time and Money Matters • Adam Tornhill [VIDEO]

That's a great visual presentation, but not really an innovation. The CodeScene tool has that built in together with a set of deep analyses on top (see [LINK] ). There are several public conference talks that cover this visualization and related use cases: [VIDEO]
